Info

Concrete implementation of binary actuator and tool frame builder.

class scaralang.infrastructure.protocol.binary.builder.actuator.BinaryActuatorFrameBuilder(*, packer: IBinaryFramePacker)[source]¶

Bases: object

Builds tool and motor configuration binary frames using injected wire frame packer.

It defines:

attributes:
BYTE_MASK - Bitmask isolating single byte values (0xFF).
TOOL_CMD_FORMAT - Struct format for 2-byte tool actuation payload.
CONFIG_MOTOR_FORMAT - Struct format for 2-byte motor config payload.
_packer - Injected wire frame packer service port.
methods:
__init__ - Initializes builder with wire frame packer collaborator.
build_tool_cmd - Builds tool state actuation frame.
build_motor_config_cmd - Builds motor configuration frame.
get_version - Returns component version string.
BYTE_MASK: ClassVar[int] = 255¶
CONFIG_MOTOR_FORMAT: ClassVar[str] = '<BB'¶
TOOL_CMD_FORMAT: ClassVar[str] = '<BB'¶
_packer: IBinaryFramePacker¶
build_motor_config_cmd(*, seq_num: int, mode: int, axis_mask: int = AxisMask.ALL) → BinaryFrame[source]¶

Builds a motor actuation mode configuration frame.

Parameters:

  • seq_num – Cyclic sequence index.

  • mode – Motor drive mode integer (0=OPEN_LOOP, 1=CLOSED_LOOP).

  • axis_mask – Bitmask of target axes (default AxisMask.ALL).

Returns:

Assembled motor configuration BinaryFrame.

Exceptions:

None.

build_tool_cmd(*, seq_num: int, tool_id: int, state: bool) → BinaryFrame[source]¶

Builds a tool actuation command frame (PUMP, VALVE).

Parameters:

  • seq_num – Cyclic sequence index.

  • tool_id – Tool identifier (0=PUMP, 1=VALVE).

  • state – True to activate, False to deactivate.

Returns:

Assembled tool command BinaryFrame.

Exceptions:

None.
